name: Champion
summary: A relentless warrior who pursues physical excellence in combat.
description: Champions focus on the development of martial prowess in a straightforward, rigorous style. They combine rigorous training with physical excellence to deal devastating blows.

features.name: Improved Critical
features.description: Your attack rolls with weapons and Unarmed Strikes can score a Critical Hit on a roll of 19 or 20 on the d20.

features.name: Remarkable Athlete
features.description: You have Advantage on Initiative rolls and Strength (Athletics) checks. In addition, immediately after you score a Critical Hit, you can move up to half your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

features.name: Additional Fighting Style
features.description: You gain another Fighting Style feat of your choice.

features.name: Superior Critical
features.description: Your attack rolls with weapons and Unarmed Strikes can now score a Critical Hit on a roll of 18-20 on the d20.

features.name: Survivor
features.description: You attain the pinnacle of resilience in battle. You have Advantage on Death Saving Throws, and at the start of each of your turns you regain Hit Points equal to 5 plus your Constitution modifier if you are Bloodied and have at least 1 Hit Point.

name: Evoker
summary: A wizard who sculpts explosive elemental magic.
description: You focus your study on magic that creates powerful elemental effects such as bitter cold, searing flame, rolling thunder, crackling lightning, and burning acid.

features.name: Evocation Savant
features.description: Choose two Wizard spells from the Evocation school, each of which must be level 1 or 2, and add them to your spellbook for free.

features.name: Potent Cantrip
features.description: Your damaging cantrips affect even creatures that avoid the brunt of the effect. When a creature succeeds on a saving throw against your cantrip, the creature takes half the damage (if any) but suffers no additional effect from the cantrip.

features.name: Sculpt Spells
features.description: You can create pockets of relative safety within the effects of your evocations. When you cast an Evocation spell that affects other creatures you can see, you can choose a number of them equal to 1 plus the spell's level; the chosen creatures automatically succeed on their saving throws against the spell and take no damage if they would normally take half damage on a successful save.

features.name: Empowered Evocation
features.description: You can add your Intelligence modifier to one damage roll of any Wizard Evocation spell you cast.

features.name: Overchannel
features.description: You can increase the power of your spells. When you cast a Wizard spell of levels 1-5 that deals damage, you can deal maximum damage with it. The first time you do so, you suffer no adverse effect; using it again before you finish a Long Rest deals necrotic damage to you.
